function armCtx2d(s): boolean;

Defined in: website/components/home/about/glitch/session.ts:196

Claims the 2D backend on the session canvas and rebuilds the channel ghosts + scanline tile against the already-measured cover rect. Called directly when WebGPU is absent and by the wasm arm on mount/upload failure — the painter pipeline is the permanent fallback.

Parameters

s

GlitchSession

Live session (geometry already measured).

Returns

boolean

false when the context claim fails — the session is unusable.
